claims.subject: oko

evidence.quote: I've been putting a team together to steal something important from an outlaw you may know as Akul.
She was going to do whatever it took to stop Akul—even if it meant aligning herself with a crew like this.

claims.summary: Oko recruits Annie Flash into his crew to rob Akul, and she joins to stop him.

claims.subject: ashiok

evidence.quote: "This is Ashiok," Oko said. "They deal in nightmares and can extract information from a person's mind. They hired us to break into the vault."
They are acting on my behalf to break into the vault, and they will be paid well for it, as will you.

claims.summary: Ashiok hires Oko's crew to break into the vault Maag Taranau.
claims.limitation: Stated in dialogue by Oko and Ashiok.

claims.subject: akul

evidence.quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built an entire town around the vault hoping to control it.

claims.summary: Akul and the Hellspurs built the town of Tarnation around the vault to control it.

evidence.quote: Besides, he was Oko's son, and that meant something.

claims.subject: oko

evidence.quote: Oko had stolen from Bertram Graywater—twice—which made everyone in their crew a target.

claims.summary: Oko steals from Bertram Graywater twice, making the whole crew a target.

claims.subject: gisa

evidence.quote: Gisa and Geralf stood on opposite sides of the room, clearly at war with one another.

claims.summary: The necromancer siblings Gisa and Geralf are openly at odds while in Oko's crew.

claims.subject: vraska

evidence.quote: Vraska faced them, tendrils swaying in the air, and locked eyes with one after another until all of them were stone.

claims.summary: Vraska turns a group of Hellspurs to stone.
claims.limitation: Only the group she faces in this scene, not the whole gang.

claims.subject: rakdos

evidence.quote: Akul was sprawled out on the floor, eyes shut in defeat.
Pinning his limp body to the ground was a victorious Rakdos.

claims.summary: Rakdos defeats Akul at the vault.

claims.subject: ral_zarek

evidence.quote: Ral stared at the half-broken altar in confusion.
"It doesn't matter anymore. Whatever was inside this vault is gone."

claims.summary: Ral reaches the vault's treasure room and finds that whatever was inside is gone.
claims.limitation: Ral's motive is inferred from his reaction to the empty altar.

claims.subject: elesh_norn

evidence.quote: Jace sends the illusion to Elesh Norn's side and is grateful that despite her dominance, she is still a psychic amateur.
He mentally clings, sputters, and feels his body begin to planeswalk to the location Norn has assigned him.

claims.summary: The epilogue retells Jace's time as a compleated Phyrexian at the Invasion Tree: he deceives Elesh Norn with an illusion, and she sends him to Vryn.
claims.limitation: Told from Jace's fevered point of view; retells events from the March of the Machine story.

claims.subject: jace_beleren

evidence.quote: Vraska is in his arms, and he feels her open her eyes as they traverse the aether.
He trips forward once again, cable detaching and blood splattering behind them, and both he and Vraska collapse onto a handwoven rug on another plane.

claims.summary: Jace planeswalks the wounded Vraska off a rooftop to another plane.

claims.subject: jace_beleren

evidence.quote: Jace lies next to Vraska on his mother's floor, both bleeding and broken.
It takes a moment for Jace to remember his great fortune; his mother would have no idea what a gorgon is.
There aren't any on Vryn.

claims.summary: Jace brings Vraska to his healer mother's home on Vryn.

remaining: Annie's nephew and the Sterling Company plot are not graded
What was inside Maag Taranau is not identified
The full roster of Oko's crew is not modelled
